2121046215974359205.en_summary: Jensen is a friend & legend. But he was not a one man show. He built an exceptional company of 42k people (31k in R&D alone) led by brilliant leaders like Jonah, Arjun, Sameer, Ashish, Gilad, Andrew, Dwight, Deb, Jeff, Ian, Colette, etc. They run key parts. Unsung heroes delivering sophisticated AI products. Despite noise, delivered Blackwell & Rubin GPUs & Vera CPUs. Following playbook for Rubin Ultra in 2027 & Feynman in 2028. Colette Kress no better interim leader, knows every nook, will make trains run on time, allocate capital best. Dose of realism: Silicon Valley not run by 10 rock stars. Founders essential but great ones attract legends. Nowhere more true than Nvidia.
2121046215974359205.zh_summary: Jensen 是朋友和傳奇。但他不是一個人的表演。他建立了一家由42k人（僅研發31k人）組成的卓越公司，由 Jonah、Arjun、Sameer、Ashish、Gilad、Andrew、Dwight、Deb、Jeff、Ian、Colette 等傑出領導者帶領。他們運營關鍵部分。無名英雄交付最精密的 AI 產品。盡管有噪音，仍交付了 Blackwell 和 Rubin GPU 以及 Vera CPU。遵循劇本確保 2027 年的 Rubin Ultra 和 2028 年的 Feynman。Colette Kress 是最好的臨時領導者，了解每一個角落，將讓列車準時運行，將資本分配到最佳用途。一劑現實主義：矽谷不是由10個搖滾明星運營的。創始人至關重要，但偉大的人吸引自己的傳奇。沒有比 Nvidia 更真實的地方。

ticker_notes.NVDA: 公司有42k人，Colette Kress 適合臨時領導，產品路線圖繼續
